info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Utility Billing Disputes-v5-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Dispute Management API facilitates the retrieval of utility billing disputes, allowing users to effectively track and manage issues related to billing discrepancies. This API enables consumers, such as utility service providers and customer service representatives, to access detailed information about outstanding disputes and their respective statuses. Typical use cases include monitoring disputes raised by customers, resolving billing issues, and ensuring timely and accurate communication with affected users. By streamlining access to dispute information, the API enhances operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information regarding their billing disputes. It provides insights into the status and resolution options available for each dispute, facilitating effective management of billing issues.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve dispute details related to billing. It provides the necessary structure for the client to specify parameters for fetching relevant dispute information.

ListUtilityBillingDisputesRequest.description: A request body placeholder for the operations related to billing disputes.
